label: Strait of Hormuz - the same 10 rounds, as Iran saw it
note: Identical run, exported to the Iranian delegation's perspective. This is a TWO-party table, so there is no caucus to withhold - a caucus needs at least two members, and excluding one of two parties leaves one. What differs here is field-level: the opposing delegation's red lines, BATNA and debrief are scrubbed from the shared context, outcome and round summaries. Entry count is therefore identical to the operator view. For withheld ENTRIES, see the three-seat supply negotiation.
